webhooks.detail: Callback style: set pingback_url (notify on task completion) or postback_url (POST results to your server) per task. No event-subscription management API.

evidence.quote: Alternatively, you can specify `pingback_url` or `postback_url` when setting a task

sandbox.detail: Sandbox free for any registered user. Returns dummy data only. Same rate limits as production.

evidence.quote: Sandbox is completely free for any registered user at DataForSEO.

rate_limits.summary: 10000 API calls/min total, max 100 tasks per POST (live: 1 task per POST); some APIs stricter (e.g. Google Ads live 12/min)

evidence.quote: You can send up to 10000 POST and GET API calls per minute in total, with each POST call containing no more than 100 tasks.
